title: u64 keys in the standard HashMap, by hasher
summary: Build Rust's standard HashMap<u64, u64> with each crate's hasher, insert integer keys (sequential, random, multiples of a power of two, near the top of the range), look up present and absent keys and remove a third.
notes: Cargo only. Every entry uses std::collections::HashMap<u64, u64, S> created with S::default(), so the figures differ only by the hasher. Keys that are multiples of 2^12, 2^16 and 2^32 make identity and weak multiplicative hashes collide; that cost is part of the figure. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures.
